verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a built-in research agent that chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search and similar-paper discovery. Deep Search produces literature reviews in minutes, and Threads supports conversational follow-up, so users can hand research tasks to the in-product AI. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how tasks are scoped, executed and reviewed by the agent, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of how well delegation works.
